title: The Part Library page has no button that creates an entry
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Part Library entry {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOCREATE-01) exists, made by creating an inventory part with that number at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  2. Look at the page title row, the toolbar and the area above the table.
  3. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  4. Click the checkbox of the {Part-A} row.
  5. Click the ⋮ icon at the left end of the table's header row.
  6. Press Escape to close the menu.
  7. Click the {Part-A} row (not its checkbox).
  8. Click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  9. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The toolbar holds Search, "Manufacturer: All manufacturers" and "Category: All categories". There is no button or link that creates an entry: no "New Catalog Part", no "New Library Part", no "New", "Add" or "+" control.
  • Step 5: The header menu offers actions for the ticked rows (such as Set category) and nothing that creates a new entry.
  • Step 7: The row opens that entry's detail page, not a dialog for creating an entry.
  • Step 8: The pencil opens the "Edit Library Part" window, which edits the existing entry (its fields hold {Part-A}). No dialog for creating a new entry can be reached anywhere on the page.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S11-R1, S11-R2, §4 Key Decisions, S11-R3, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 7.1 (Part Library), board 7.0 (Before: the Catalog page today), board 7.2 (An entry opens its detail page), 13 Oct copy. Product's answer of 13 Oct (Chris Ward, question 12). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R1: “The Part Library page has no control that creates a Part Library entry.”
  • S11-R2: “No dialog for creating a Part Library entry can be reached from the Part Library page.”
  • PRD §4 Key Decisions (The Part Library has no standalone create): “The Part Library has no standalone create. Every Part Library entry is created from a part number in use.”
  • S11-R3: “Clicking a row opens that entry's detail page. The pencil beside the entry's name opens the "Edit Library Part" window, where the entry is edited and where its Delete button sits, bottom left. The detail page itself has no Delete button.”
